verdict.rationale: Highnote explicitly documents an agentic-commerce use case: issuing scoped virtual cards per agent/workflow/vendor via API with automatic closure, plus merchant category restrictions, velocity limits, and per-transaction caps enforced at authorization time (docs-17, docs-18, docs-21), backed by general spend-rule and velocity-control infrastructure (docs-8, docs-9, docs-29, docs-30). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs of the agent-specific feature working in production.
